newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING sees higher EPS in 1996.
newsitem.headline: ING sees higher EPS in 1996.

text.p: Financial services group ING Groep NV (ING) said on Thursday it expected a clear increase in earnings per share over the whole of 1996 compared with 1995.

"Despite the increase in share capital through stock dividends and the conversion of warrants, ING expects, on the basis of the nine month result, that net profits per share over the whole of 1996 will be clearly higher compared to 1995," ING said.
ING's earnings per share (EPS) in 1995 were 9.60 guilders, up from 8.71 guilders a year earlier.
But in March this year, the company had a 2.5 for one share split, increasing the number of shares on issue.
ING earlier announced a net profit of 2.34 billion guilders for the first nine months of 1996, compared with 1.88 billion for the same period a year earlier.
The net profit for the full 1995 year was 2.65 billion guilders.
